model: frozen DINOv3-L/16, same timm converted server checkpoint

secondary_metric: same predictions at 1024 with official nearest-resized GT
ignore: official five loaders return no ignore map; COCO non-target pixels including 255 become background
crf: unchanged original Frank-Wolfe 10 iterations/parameters, repaired CPU NHWC float32 binding
query_labels: protocol preparation may materialize masks; candidate inference never reads query masks; score after seal
baseline_B0: FoRIS evidence -> fixed RCG -> historical fine (sigma1.25, tau0.15, window2) -> threshold0.5, no size/cut fitting
bootstrap: 100000 paired episode draws within fold/class, independent RandomState(0), conditional on image pool
final_target: all five official datasets exceed complete FoRIS with paired 95% CI lower bound >0
candidates: not opened before stage0 and prerequisites
